titulo.en: I was, I could, I said

intro.en: Ten more verbs with an irregular indefinido. They share a new stem and one set of endings with no accents.

supe.nota: Saber in the indefinido usually means found out.

dijeron.nota: After j the ending is -eron: dijeron, trajeron.

di.nota: Di and vi are one syllable and have no accent.

hice.consejo: In much of Spain, c before e/i is /θ/. In seseante varieties, including most of Latin America, it is /s/.

hizo.consejo: In much of Spain, z is /θ/; in seseante varieties, it is /s/.

texto.en:
Many common verbs change their stem in the indefinido. First learn these high-frequency forms: estar → **estuv-** (estuve, estuvo); tener → **tuv-**; poder → **pud-**; poner → **pus-**; venir → **vin-**; hacer → **hic-** (él/ella **hizo**).

They use the same endings: **-e, -iste, -o, -imos, -isteis, -ieron**. The endings have no written accent: estuve, tuviste, pudo.

Add these after the first group: querer → **quis-**; saber → **sup-**; decir → **dij-**; traer → **traj-**. With a stem ending in **j**, ellos/ellas uses **-eron**: dijeron, trajeron.

**Dar** and **ver** have short forms: di, diste, dio, dimos, disteis, dieron; vi, viste, vio, vimos, visteis, vieron. Remember: **dio** and **vio** have no written accent.

frases.es: ¿Por qué no viniste a la fiesta?
frases.en: Why didn't you come to the party?

frases.es: No pude. Estuve en el hospital con mi madre.
frases.en: I couldn't. I was at the hospital with my mother.
I'm sorry. What did you all do?

frases.es: Ana trajo una tarta y le dimos el regalo.
frases.en: Ana brought a cake and we gave her the present.

pregunta.en: Complete: I was in Madrid for three days.

Estuvé.en: These irregular forms have no accent.

Esté.en: Esté is not the indefinido of estar.

Decieron.en: Decir changes its stem to dij-.

pregunta.en: Which is the él form of poner in the indefinido?

puso.en: Poner → pus-, and él takes -o with no accent.

ponió.en: Poner is irregular: the stem is pus-.

pusó.en: The irregular forms are stressed on the stem: puso.

bloques.frase: ¿Por qué no viniste a la fiesta?

traduccion.en: Why didn't you come to the party?

texto.en:
**The app cannot check this part.** For the writing, please use pen and paper. For the speaking, say it out loud and, if you can, practise with a native speaker or a teacher who can correct you.

**Write (60–80 words).** Write about a day when everything went wrong. Use at least six irregular past forms: estuve, tuve, pude, dije, vine, puse…

**Speak (about 1 minute).** Tell aloud what you did last weekend, using estuve, tuve que, pude and quise.
